reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune. Imported from CCEH tune 001399 (the melody read from 001399a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Sir Joseph Barnby's dates (1838–1896) are from our page for the tune GALILEAN (content/hymns/tunes/galilean.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001399a.nwc). The tune ends on Ab, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
